signed_rows.behavior: kmctl schema with no name lists every document kind with what it is for; an unknown kind is refused with that list.
signed_rows.fails_when: the list lacks any of decision, practice, proposal, prototype, handoff, manifesto, index, section-index, log, architecture, tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation, docs-index; or an unknown kind exits 0 or does not list the kinds

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl schema KIND prints valid JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) whose properties are fields from ALLOWED_FIELDS only, with required, allowed values and descriptions, and the body's expected sections in x-kmctl-sections.
signed_rows.fails_when: for any kind the output is not valid draft 2020-12 JSON Schema, names a property not in ALLOWED_FIELDS, has a property without a description, or lacks x-kmctl-sections

signed_rows.behavior: Everything kmctl init, kmctl new (each kind, with and without --stale-after and --source) and kmctl new doc (each type) writes matches its kind's schema: front matter validates and the ## sections appear in the listed order.
signed_rows.fails_when: any file those verbs write fails its kind's schema, or its ## sections differ from x-kmctl-sections or come in another order

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl schema's help says what the schema is and where it comes from, and the briefing names kmctl schema within its word budget.
signed_rows.fails_when: kmctl schema --help does not say the schema is built from kmctl's code and is what kmctl check and the strict validator expect, the briefing does not name kmctl schema, or the briefing budget test fails
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_schema.py -k documented tests/test_briefing.py -q
